name: Reachy Mini 3D Voice
description: Talk by voice to a 3D Reachy Mini, fully in the browser

paragraphs: Fork of smolagents/hf-realtime-voice where the orb is replaced by a rigged 3D Reachy Mini (Draco GLB, three.js): procedural motion per conversational state, a speech-synced head wobble driven by the assistant's voice, and emotion/dance tools the model calls mid-conversation. Emotions replay the official recorded head, antenna, and body trajectories from Pollen's pinned emotions dataset; dances reproduce the official dance library. Same deployment shape as upstream — a thin FastAPI serving the static front-end, proxying /session, and metering talk time. Its WebSocket transport is driven by the…

requirements.text: It is discovered at page load and requires no API key in this Space.
Setting it disables the load-balancer logic entirely (no /api/session proxy, no queue, no metering, no sign-in).
Set REQUIRELOGIN=true to reject anonymous allocation and ask visitors to sign in before starting.
